record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.75 to 0.74. The regressions at 0.70 and 0.775 motivate a smaller local probe around the incumbent rather than assuming a monotonic benefit. Preserve width 64, input/output tying, frequency modulation, topology, scoring, history, loss temperature and optimizer. Apply the identical effective-weight definition during training and prediction.
